summary_claims.claim: High-risk criteria: Art. 2(1)-(2) of the Decision cite Law Art. 9 and Decree Art. 8(1), exclusion Decree Art. 8(2)

Art. 1(2): use of AI does not change, transfer or exclude the powers and responsibilities of competent bodies; human supervision, control and ability to intervene ('bao dam su giam sat, kiem soat va kha nang can thiep cua con nguoi')
Annex headings: education, ethnic and religious affairs, health, banking, 'to tung' (legal proceedings), transport; numbering restarts per section and transport ends at 31
Art. 4 transition: 1 Sep 2027 (health, education, finance), 1 Mar 2027 (others); systems started within 6 months by 1 Mar 2027
